body:
Owner request: no run ends without useful work landed. This adds a "Every run ships something useful" section to `CLAUDE.md`. When the tracks have nothing, the run comes up with something new and valuable and ships it. The integrity rules still apply.

The companion change is Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo#7010 (its `CLAUDE.md` and `prompts/goals.md`). `CLAUDE.md` is one of the files ported by hand at each mirror sync, and this is that change.
